findings.name: forget
findings.description: Delete a previously stored memory by key. Use when context is stale, the task is done, or you want to clear sensitive data the agent saved earlier. Pair with remember and recall.

findings.name: worlds
findings.description: Fetch Guild Wars 2 world (server) details by comma-separated IDs, or return the full index of world IDs; includes world name and population level.

findings.name: items
findings.description: Fetch Guild Wars 2 item details by comma-separated IDs or by page; returns item name, type, rarity, level, vendor value, icon, and game flags.

findings.name: achievements
findings.description: Fetch Guild Wars 2 achievement details by comma-separated IDs or by page; returns achievement name, description, category, tiers, point rewards, and prerequisites.

findings.name: commerce_prices
findings.description: Bulk Guild Wars 2 Trading Post buy/sell quotes for many numeric item IDs at once; returns the raw copper unit_price and open quantity on each side for every ID passed. Use guild_wars_2_item_price for a single item looked up by its name with gold/silver/copper formatting.

findings.name: commerce_listings
findings.description: Guild Wars 2 Trading Post order-book depth for numeric item IDs; returns every standing buy and sell listing tier with its copper unit price, listing count, and quantity, so you can see how deep the book is at each price level.

findings.name: guild_wars_2_item_price

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_pipeworx, deep_research, subscribe, list_subscriptions, recent_alerts, bet_research, polymarket_fill_risk, pipeworx_feedback, commerce_prices · Private data: ask_pipeworx, search_within, deep_research, entity_profile, validate_claim, bet_research, polymarket_arbitrage, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, pipeworx_feedback · Public sink: subscribe, polymarket_kalshi_spread, polymarket_fill_risk, remember, commerce_prices, commerce_listings, guild_wars_2_item_price · Destructive: polymarket_edges, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, remember, recall, forget.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_pipeworx, deep_research, subscribe, list_subscriptions, recent_alerts, bet_research, polymarket_fill_risk, pipeworx_feedback, commerce_prices · Private data: ask_pipeworx, search_within, deep_research, entity_profile, validate_claim, bet_research, polymarket_arbitrage, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, pipeworx_feedback · Public sink: subscribe, polymarket_kalshi_spread, polymarket_fill_risk, remember, commerce_prices, commerce_listings, guild_wars_2_item_price · Destructive: polymarket_edges, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, remember, recall, forget

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
